page: Notes app: six changes to All notes and Trash

rows.change: Note editor Back reads 'All notes' instead of a bare chevron
Visible search field under the title instead of a magnifier icon
Pinned rows 64 pt like other rows (today 56 pt)
'Empty Trash' moves from the All notes toolbar to the Trash screen
New note button gets a text label

documents.note: Agree, but the design is poor: the field looks cramped against the title.
Not sure 'All notes' is clearer when there are folders.
Pinned should stay a bit different, it's how people spot them.
Will people find it if it only lives in Trash?
